baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun السماء is an overhead covering and the passive كشطت names removal of a cover.
baseline_models.mechanism: The elevated surface functions as the world's roof. Its removal does more than deform a celestial object: it cancels enclosure and exposes whatever the roof had kept outside sight.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky as an upper cover supplies the enclosing surface whose function is undone.
Removing a cover and exposing the hidden makes the passive event an operation of disclosure.

changed_reading.before: A catastrophic alteration happens somewhere in the sky.
changed_reading.after: The world's upper cover is taken away, converting enclosure into exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The covering sense of السماء meets the explicit skin-removal branch of كشط.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky can be imagined as a fitted membrane or hide rather than empty distance. The passive verb then presents the world as a body whose outer skin is being flayed.

activation_trace.role: The upper covering gives the sky a surface-like material role.
Removing an animal's hide supplies the flaying operation applied to that upper surface.

changed_reading.before: The sky is removed like an architectural roof.
changed_reading.after: The sky is peeled as a living world's fitted outer membrane.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of س م و includes a visible identifying mark and a sign read by observation, while كشط removes a concealing layer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky is also a readable field by which the world's condition is recognized. Stripping can either erase that familiar identifying surface or remove its cover so that a deeper sign becomes legible; the focus wording alone leaves both directions live.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark recasts the sky as the world's recognizable marked surface.
A condition inferred from a visible sign makes the sky a medium of legibility.
Cover-removal supplies the reversible ambiguity between erasing a surface and exposing what lies under it.

changed_reading.before: Only a physical canopy is removed.
changed_reading.after: The world's familiar sign-surface is stripped away, or stripped open, changing what can be recognized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus becomes the culminating boundary-operation in a sequence that bundles a luminary, sends stellar bodies down in dispersion, displaces the solid supports of terrain, and finally removes the upper cover.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the last large-scale boundary acted on in the sequence.
Cover-removal gives the sequence its terminal act of exposure.
Wrapping and gathering parts together supplies a compressive handling of the sun before the sky is opened.
Scattered plunging supplies the dispersive failure of the stars within the cover.
Displacement and removal supply the loss of the terrain's apparently fixed supports.

structural_cues: 81:1-3 precede 81:11 with the same passive conditional cadence and act successively on sun, stars, and mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four differently directed material operations; I infer a progressive dismantling from contents and supports to enclosure, while the live alternative is a list of independent signs without one spatial order.

changed_reading.before: The sky-cover is removed as an isolated catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: Its removal completes an ordered unmaking of the world's visible containment system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stars first lose their elevated placement, while a later branch supplies the image of a neck left without jewelry. Together they permit a second syntax of stripping: the sky may remain as a bare surface after its luminous ornaments have been torn from it.

activation_trace.role: The upper surface provides the body on which celestial ornaments had appeared.
Stripping a cover also supports denuding a surface of what had covered or adorned it.
The rising star supplies the luminous objects normally set on the sky's face.
Scattered descent removes those lights from their ordered placement.
A neck without ornament supplies the bodily analogy for a sky left bare of stars.

structural_cues: 81:2 removes the stars before 81:11 acts on the sky, and 81:4 inserts abandonment beside the image of an unadorned neck.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fallen stars and an unadorned neck; I assign stars the role of sky-jewelry, while the live alternative remains that the sky itself, rather than its adornment, is wholly removed.

changed_reading.before: The sky itself is peeled away.
changed_reading.after: The sky can instead be stripped bare of its ordered lights and left as a denuded surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning draws out a concealed killing, written sheets are opened, and a self finally encounters what it made present. The stripped sky becomes the removal of the courtroom roof: no protected interior remains in which deed, victim, record, or knowledge can stay hidden.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the enclosure under which evidence could have remained concealed.
Removing the cover supplies the transition from protected concealment to public exposure.
Question and demand introduce an accountable procedure rather than mute spectacle.
The split mapping's hidden extraction image lets questioning draw buried testimony into view.
Guilt supplies the legal category being tested by the question.
Taking life supplies the concealed deed that must become evidentially present.
The written sheet supplies durable documentary evidence.
Opening and spreading makes the documentary evidence inspectable.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic result of the exposure.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness bring the deed into the subject's immediate encounter.

structural_cues: 81:8's branchless و ء د victim is retained only as a structural cue: the hidden victim is made the grammatical addressee of inquiry.
81:8-10 move from questioning a killing to opening records, and 81:14 resolves the conditional series in self-knowledge of what was brought.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inquiry, guilt, killing, opened records, knowledge, and presence; I infer that removing the sky-cover is the spatial counterpart of removing evidentiary concealment, while the alternative is that these are parallel events without causal dependence.

changed_reading.before: The sky is physically uncovered during cosmic collapse.
changed_reading.after: The world is unroofed into a court where suppressed testimony, records, and deeds become present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreat into hiding, stellar entry into shelters, darkness thinning at the night's edge, and dawn opening like breath form a reversible concealment-to-appearance rhythm. The sky's stripping can therefore be carried as a threshold transition as well as irreversible destruction.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover is the large-scale medium through which hiding and appearance alternate.
Cover-removal marks the decisive passage from concealment to exposure.
Withdrawal into hiding supplies one pole of the visibility cycle.
Stars disappearing into shelters spatializes celestial concealment.
Thin darkness at either edge of night supplies a boundary that changes phase rather than simply vanishing.
First light supplies the appearing state after the cover of night recedes.
Dawn opening like breath gives disclosure an organic expanding motion.

structural_cues: 81:15-18 arranges withdrawal, sheltering, an edge-state of night, and breathing dawn immediately after the catastrophe series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an alternation of hiding and emergence; I infer that 81:11 participates in that visibility grammar, while the materially live alternative treats its stripping as uniquely final and noncyclical.

changed_reading.after: Uncovering is also a phase-change in visibility, the cosmic-scale counterpart of night yielding to breathing dawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later raised royal canopy and a secure station complicate the first impression of absolute rooflessness. One overhead structure is removable, while another image of elevation is tied to durable authority and emplacement; stripping reveals a hierarchy rather than empty space alone.

activation_trace.role: The sky as raised cover supplies the lower canopy that can be removed.
Removing that cover supplies access beyond the first apparent ceiling.
An elevated royal seat supplies the authority encountered beyond ordinary visible order.
A raised roof or canopy creates a direct architectural counter-image to the stripped sky-cover.
Established station contrasts durable placement with the displacement of the visible sky.

structural_cues: 81:20 locates strength and established standing عند ذي العرش after the stripped-sky sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two elevated cover-images and an established station; I infer an architectural contrast between a removable visible roof and a more durable order, while the alternative reads عرش solely as royal seat with no canopy relation.

changed_reading.before: The sky's removal leaves undifferentiated roofless absence.
changed_reading.after: The first ceiling is stripped to disclose a higher order of elevation, authority, and emplacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence joins signifying speech, transmission, trust, direct sight at the far boundary, explicit manifestation, and non-withholding of what is hidden. The stripped sky becomes an opened visual-semantic channel through which a reliable message crosses the former limit.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the former limit between observer and what lies beyond sight.
Exposure of what was hidden turns the removed cover into an aperture for disclosure.
A thing's signification makes speech the semantic content passing through the opened limit.
Messenger and message supply the transmission relation across that limit.
Security and trust supply the reliability condition of the transmission.
Vision by eye or insight supplies direct reception rather than merely inferred report.
The distant horizon supplies the visible edge at which the former enclosure is crossed.
Appearance and uncovering name the manifest state produced at that edge.
What is screened from eyes supplies the informational interior formerly behind the cover.
Withholding, structurally negated in the ayah, supplies the blocked flow that the passage denies.

structural_cues: 81:19-24 identifies a trustworthy transmitted saying, places a seeing event at the clear horizon, and negates withholding concerning the hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a communication chain and a visibility chain; I infer that stripping the sky spatializes the opening of that channel, while the alternative is that the later claims verify the message without making 81:11 a transmission image.

changed_reading.before: The sky-cover is removed only to expose an unspecified beyond.
changed_reading.after: Its removal opens a horizon-channel in which hidden content becomes reliably visible and communicable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A leather strap appears in an early branch inventory, then a hairy hide and a horizon-hide appear in adjacent late contexts. These materially distant echoes make the focus verb's skinning branch persist as a tactile model rather than dissolve into a generic metaphor.

activation_trace.role: The sky as an upper covering supplies the large hide-like surface.
Literal hide-removal provides the material operation around which the distant leather images cluster.
A strip of leather supplies the first non-focus fragment of the hide-working material field.
A hide retaining its hair gives the sky-skin model a pelt-like texture.
The horizon lexeme's hide branch places hide-material at the visible edge of the sky.

structural_cues: The leather image at 81:3 precedes the focus, while the hide images at 81:22-23 recur in adjacent ayat around the visible horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branch-level leather and hide images whose surface words mean other things here; I infer cross-branch material coactivation, while coincidence and branch-distance remain fully live alternatives.

changed_reading.before: Flaying is one isolated lexical possibility of كشط.
changed_reading.after: The sky's flaying participates in a recurrent leather-and-hide material field extending to the horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Identifying traces and disclosure by signs first strengthen the sky as a legible field. The later question of where one goes, followed by a reminder with documentary force and the possibility of straightness, then relocates orientation: when the old celestial sign-surface is stripped, direction must be recovered ethically rather than read from the familiar canopy.

activation_trace.role: A sign read by discerning observation makes the sky an orienting field.
Stripping the cover removes or opens the familiar field from which orientation was read.
An identifying trace that guides recognition reinforces the mark-and-reading mechanism.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign supplies a replacement mode of legibility.
A path, place, or method gives the question of going an explicit orientation frame.
A document of right supplies a normative record that can orient after visual markers fail.
Straightness, balance, and evenness supply the directional state sought from the new orientation.

structural_cues: 81:26 asks where the hearers are going, and 81:27-28 immediately place reminder and straightness beside that directional question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marks, disclosed meaning, path, a right-document, and straightness; I infer that loss of the sky's ordinary markers motivates ethical reorientation, while the alternative leaves the directional passage independent of the sky event.

changed_reading.before: Stripping the sky destroys a visual object but leaves orientation conceptually unchanged.
changed_reading.after: Stripping the old sign-field forces orientation to move from celestial familiarity to disclosed reminder and chosen straightness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines two non-dominant س م م branches from the split mapping with the ordinary uncovering verb. It remains anchored in both focus words and yields one coherent boundary mechanism, but downstream prose should present it only as an aperture analogy, not as a lexical replacement for السماء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split focus inventory supplies both a narrow entry-hole and stoppering, while كشط supplies removal of its cover.

activation_trace.role: A narrow opening of entry supplies an aperture hidden in the upper boundary.
Stoppering and tightening supplies the prior sealed state of that aperture.
Cover-removal acts like withdrawing the stopper and exposing passage through the boundary.

changed_reading.before: A roof is peeled away from above.
changed_reading.after: The upper boundary is unstoppered, turning enclosure into an opening between inside and outside.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ذهاب الروع is an idiomatic and affective branch beside a strongly physical passive scene. It remains directly anchored in the focus verb and the looming elevated sky, but downstream prose should treat it as an affective undertone, not as the clause's primary syntactic sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A looming raised outline is paired with the كشط branch in which terror departs.

activation_trace.role: The looming elevated outline supplies the awe-producing object overhead.
Terror departing shifts the stripping operation from material cover to affective hold.

changed_reading.before: The event only increases cosmic terror by destroying the sky.
changed_reading.after: The sky's old power to overawe is itself stripped, with terror paradoxically departing as exposure arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain page analogy, surprising because the packet never states that the sky is writing material. It remains anchored by the sky-cover, the focus act of uncovering, and the adjacent broad written sheets being opened; downstream prose should render the sky only as if it were an upper folio, not assert that as direct denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The upper cover is removed immediately after broad written sheets are spread open.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies the top sheet-like surface.
Lifting a cover supplies the action of peeling back the upper folio.
Breadth and flat extension give the records a surface analogous to the sky.
The written sheet supplies the folio material whose contents can be exposed.
Opening and spreading supplies the page-motion immediately preceding the sky's uncovering.

changed_reading.after: The sky is peeled back like the upper folio of a record, exposing another layer of legibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it supplies a causal physiology that the packet does not state. It remains anchored by an enclosing sky, its removal, and the later branches for air leaving an interior and dawn opening; downstream prose should qualify it as an organic image of disclosure rather than a physical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The world's upper membrane is removed, while the later dawn sequence activates breath leaving an interior.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover supplies a membrane that had contained an interior.
Removing the membrane permits the imagined release across its boundary.
Air exiting an interior supplies the decompressive motion.
Dawn opening like breath makes the released interior visible as new light.
First light supplies the perceptible state after the imagined release.

changed_reading.before: The cover disappears into inert absence.
changed_reading.after: Its removal lets the enclosed world exhale into dawn-like disclosure.

strongest_changes: The isolated roof-removal became the terminal boundary act in an ordered unmaking of visible cosmic containment.
The same passive can preserve a competing reading in which the sky remains but is denuded of its scattered star-ornaments.
Questioning, guilt, opened records, knowledge, and presence changed cosmic exposure into judicial unroofing.
Sight, horizon, manifestation, hiddenness, and non-withholding changed the removed cover into a revelatory aperture.
Leather and hide branches kept the flayed-sky model materially live, while mark, path, reminder, and straightness relocated orientation after the familiar sign-field failed.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root split did not merely add synonyms: it opened sign-reading and sealed-aperture models, while distant context branches unexpectedly formed coherent page, hide, canopy, legal, and visibility mechanisms around the same act of stripping.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive focus wording does not settle whether the sky itself is removed or the sky is left bare after what covered or adorned it is removed.
The و س م and س م م mappings, the affective كشط idiom, and the leather-and-hide recurrences are valid activators but remain form-distant and exploratory.
The packet supplies the linked elements but not the causal claim that sky-removal enables judgment, revelation, reorientation, or dawn-like release.
The hide, folio, and nested-canopy models may be mutually compatible material analogies, but they should remain separate rather than be fused into one literal object.
